mission.title: gitea: feature: HTTPS based deploy keys
mission.description: feature: HTTPS based deploy keys. Requested by 70+ users.

steps.title: Check current gitea setup
steps.description:
Verify your gitea version and configuration:
```bash
gitea --version
```
This feature requires a working gitea installation.

steps.title: Review gitea configuration
steps.description:
Review the relevant gitea configuration:
Hi, I have found at https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-ce/issues/20845 a really senseful feature request and would like to ask for something similar at gitea.

steps.title: Apply the fix for feature: HTTPS based deploy keys
steps.description:
That would be different to how deploy keys currently work (which are 1 per repo IIRC), but I guess one layer of indirection via a dropdown of selectable deploy keys (ssh and http) would be nice to have, but not required initially imho.

Also, it would present an issue regarding ownership of shared
```yaml
git clone https://gitlab-ci-token:<YOUR_TOKEN>@<GITLAB_INSTANCE_URL>/<USERNAME_OR_GROUPNAME/<REPO_NAME>.git
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected.
Confirm the feature described in "feature: HTTPS based deploy keys" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:
That would be different to how deploy keys currently work (which are 1 per repo IIRC), but I guess one layer of indirection via a dropdown of selectable deploy keys (ssh and http) would be nice to have, but not required initially imho.

prerequisites.description: A working gitea installation or development environment.
